command: set -o pipefail; echo '=== HOST ==='; hostname; whoami; echo '=== TOP REPOS/DIRS ==='; find "$HOME" -maxdepth 2 -type d \( -iname '*frank*' -o -iname '*entity*' -o -iname '*brain*' -o -iname '*sync*' -o -iname '*clay*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort | head -200; echo '=== SYNC/STATE/BRIDGE FILES ==='; find "$HOME/.claude" "$HOME"/frankenstein* "$HOME"/frank* "$HOME"/self-integration "$HOME"/andreas-claude -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*sync*' -o -iname '*state*' -o -iname '*brain*' -o -iname '*bridge*' -o -iname '*memory*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort | head -300; echo '=== SYSTEMD USER FRANK/SYNC/BRIDGE ==='; systemctl --user list-unit-files 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'frank|entity|sync|bridge|brain|clay' | head -100 || true
